pairs.evidence: packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:116 If any eslint-rules/<rule>.cjs shim is missing or broken inside the politicas tree, require() throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND, the runner prints SKIP and still exits 0, so the shim-equivalence check that CLAUDE.md says test:rules asserts passes green after checking nothing; eslint.config.mjs imports the package directly, so lint does not catch the missing shim either.

techniques.evidence: packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:116 A shim that could not be loaded is folded into a passing run instead of failing it. The step decides 'standalone checkout' from the error code, not by checking whether eslint-rules/ exists, so the check fails open in-repo.

packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:115 When the 'shim === package rule' condition cannot be evaluated, the step always skips. It never separates 'not applicable (standalone)' from 'evidence missing in the repo it governs'. The loop also stops at the first missing shim, so later shims go unchecked.
packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:58 Rule files, exports, docs and suites are reconciled in both directions, including the 'row with no implementation' direction.
packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:33 The prose convention 'every rule has a doc and a test' was mechanised against the filesystem after it was found drifting.

packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:83 Preset composition and severities are pinned, so the index.cjs header (a projection of the policy) cannot drift from the enforced preset.

packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/run-all.mjs:25 Each suite throws on failure. The top-level-await import turns that throw into a rejected module and a non-zero process exit, so a RuleTester failure reaches the exit code.

packages/eslint-plugin-civic-transparency/__tests__/require-source-citation.test.mjs:233 Delegation keys are verified against code, not raw file text; a comment mention does not satisfy them.
